newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BA and Lufthansa interested in SAA.
newsitem.headline: BA and Lufthansa interested in SAA.

text.p: British Airways Plc and Deutsche Lufthansa AG have both expressed interest in acquiring a strategic equity stake in South African Airways which the government plans to privatise, industry sources on Tuesday.

The government, which plans to accelerate its privatisation programme after selling 30 percent of Telkom to a U.S.-Malaysian consortium last month, intends to sell an initial stake in the South African flag carrier to an equity partner and eventually dispose of its entire interest.

Public Enterprises Minister Stella Sigcau confirmed to reporters during a press trip to Japan this week that the government planned to sell 100 percent of SAA in a phased approach which sources said would likely take several years.

SAA officials said on Monday that the state-run enterprise would show an unaudited loss of some 345 million rand for the financial year ended March 1997. But the company has budgeted to break even in the current year.
